rumor_text: The heart of the Western Alliance. A stable yellow star with rich agricultural and industrial worlds.
Ancient binary star system. Population centers on multiple worlds. Strong military presence.
Young energetic star. The Shatter asteroid belt is said to contain rare metals from a destroyed planet.
Brilliant white star. The Zarekites rule from Gilded Throne where ancient ruins predate their civilization.
Legendary Hanging Gardens orbit Astrex Prima. A center of culture and commerce for the East.
Ancient orange star said to be dying slowly. Industrial heartland with depleted resources.
First waypoint from Arven. Mostly undeveloped but strategically positioned.
Junction system between Belix and the contested zones. Trade and fishing colonies.
Distant orange star at the edge of charted space. Military outpost guards the approaches.
Young star with spectacular asteroid rings. Rumors of rich mineral deposits.
Central junction. Three warplines meet here. Heavily trafficked and contested.
One of the oldest stars known. Conservative population guards ancient ways.
Dim star beginning its expansion. Hardy colonists survive in difficult conditions.
The Axis. Four warplines converge here. Most strategic location in contested space.
Cold red dwarf near Havor. Sparse population in harsh conditions.
Bright hot star. Inner planets are furnaces. Industrial development further out.
Major crossroads world. Cosmopolitan population from many cultures.
Steady orange star near Norex. Border watchers monitor the contested zones.
Dim ancient red dwarf. Survival-focused colonies in minimal conditions.
Isolated red dwarf with single warpline. Rumors of exotic crystalline deposits and alien miners.
Gateway to eastern territories. Developing colonies with growing importance.
Four warplines meet at this heavily contested system. War-torn worlds and battle debris.
Home of the Vesh hive collective. Dim red star with dense-atmosphere worlds.
Direct route to Zarek. Strategic gateway to eastern capital.
Home of the Remnant machine civilization. Ancient mysteries abound.
Kethrani homeworld. Ocean worlds with aquatic culture and extensive trade networks.
Three-way junction. The Nexus free port welcomes all. Mercenary presence on fortress moons.
Gateway to Brion. Growing trade center with developing colonies.
